title: fw_to_local_post clones every field from PostRow
description: posting.rs:596-618. fw_to_local_post() clones every String field from fieldwork_db::posts_db::PostRow to construct the local PostRow. This happens on every status serialization in the hot path (timelines, individual post views). Consider either making PostRow borrow from the fieldwork row (PostRow<'a> with &'a str fields) or, since the fieldwork row is not used after conversion, taking ownership with an into_ conversion that moves fields instead of cloning them.
